notes.title: Heart of Enya 1.3.3 Released!
notes.content:
Thank you so much to everyone who has played and given feedback on Heart of Enya! We've identified and fixed a few major bugs - see the full list below.

Big thanks to Hanako for finding a bug that caused the game to be unplayable with a left-handed mouse. We've overhauled our input system, and the game is now 100% playable for mice with a primary right-click button. 
If you ever encounter an issue while playing the game, please post on the Community Hub or shoot us an email at heartofenya@gmail.com. We really appreciate the feedback!

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The game now functions properly when playing with right mouse button as the primary mouse button in Windows
[*] Fixed a possible softlock in the Soup tutorial
[*] Fixed some issues with pausing the game during Soup
[*] Fixed an issue with [REDACTED]'s reinforcements / frost count when starting from a camp scene in the level select
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sometimes, [REDACTED] is duplicated in the final boss fight.
[/list]
